name: h1_walk
title: H1 walk (Unitree official policy re-hosted in-engine)
summary: The Unitree official H1 walk policy (motion.pt) re-hosted and driven inside OmniSim's Newton engine -- the second humanoid in the library, and proof the manifest holds non-Shadowing RL skills. Its recorded in-engine walk was folded into ghost_h1_lut.json (the cleanest ghost: spreads .003, sway +/-1deg) which PASSes the ghost_validator all-green -- i.e. H1 has an achievable, verified ghost ready for a Shadowing corridor-train, but the shipped walker today is the re-host. Deploy launches the world (controller baked in), NOT the g1 recipe.

ghost.notes: Recorded from the official H1 walk in-engine (58.7 m / 139 s straight, 173 cycles folded, 5-harmonic smooth). 10-DOF leg track (H1, not G1's 12). Ready for a Shadowing corridor-train (not yet done).

baton.notes: Not BATON-blendable with the g1 cyclic family (different robot + obs); listed for cross-robot cataloguing. A shadowed H1 (trained via the recipe on ghost_h1_lut) would join a future h1_shadow_deploy profile.

train.notes: The shipped policy is the Unitree re-host (motion.pt), not trained here. To make a native H1 walk, corridor-train the recipe on ghost_h1_lut.json (validator already PASSes).

deploy.notes: The controller + motion.pt are baked into the .wbt; `skill_lib.py run h1_walk` just launches the world.

verification.result: Official H1 walks 58.7 m / 139 s straight in-engine; the folded ghost PASSes the validator all-green.
